in_sanskrit.name: सौरव
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who flows with the Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who moves or flows with the radiance and power of the Sun God

in_hindi.name: Sauravraj
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Sun
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sauravraj एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sauravraj is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Saur' meaning sun and 'Raj' meaning king or ruler. Thus, Sauravraj can be translated to 'Lord of the Sun'.

in_tamil.name: Sauravraj
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of the Sun
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sauravraj ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Sauravraj is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Saur' meaning sun and 'Raj' meaning king or ruler. Thus, Sauravraj can be translated to 'Lord of the Sun'.

in_telugu.name: Sauravraj
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of the Sun
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sauravraj ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Sauravraj is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Saur' meaning sun and 'Raj' meaning king or ruler. Thus, Sauravraj can be translated to 'Lord of the Sun'.

in_marathi.name: Sauravraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sauravraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sauravraj is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Saur' meaning sun and 'Raj' meaning king or ruler. Thus, Sauravraj can be translated to 'Lord of the Sun'.

in_bengali.name: Sauravraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Sun
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sauravraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sauravraj is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Saur' meaning sun and 'Raj' meaning king or ruler. Thus, Sauravraj can be translated to 'Lord of the Sun'.
